units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 8:6:5">Y. Peah VIII, 21ᵃ</cite> <he>לומר שכל ש׳ שניתנה וכ׳</he> to indicate that what authority is given to a man, is given by the Law.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 20:4">Lev. R. s. 20</cite> (in the prayer of the high priest on the Day of Atonement) <he>ואל יגביהו ישראל ש׳ וכ׳</he> and let Israel not assume high power one over the other; <he>רבנן דקסרין … שלא יגביהו ש׳</he> the Rabbis of Cæsaræa say, (he prayed,) ‘concerning our brethren in Cæsaræa, that they may not assume authority’; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 5:2:5">Y. Yoma V, 42ᶜ</cite> top. Ib. VI, 43ᵈ top <he>שברח מן הש׳</he> who fled in order not to take an office; <cite ref="Yoma 2a">ib.</cite> <he>שלא נכנס לש׳</he> who did not enter office.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:5:2">Y. Taan. IV, 68ᶜ</cite> top <he>אדם שהוא עתיד להנהיג ש׳ וכ׳</he> a man (Joshua) designated to exercise rulership over six hundred thousand men, does not know how to distinguish &c.? <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:7:1">Cant. R. to IV, 7</cite> <he>מת ראובן נתנה ש׳ וכ׳</he> when Ruben died, the leadership was offered to Simeon; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 13:8">Num. R. s. 13<sup>8</sup></cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Shekalim 5:2">Shek. V, 2</cite> <he>אין עושין ש׳ על הצבור פחות משנים</he> Y. ed. (Mish. <he>בממון פחות וכ׳</he>) no office for communal (money) affairs must be created with less than two officers; <cite ref="Bava Batra 8b">B. Bath. 8ᵇ</cite> <cite ref="U02033"><he>שְׂרָרוּת</he></cite>; a. fr.—V. <cite ref="O01680"><he>סְרָרָה</he></cite>.
